provider: Hugging Face public Gradio chat Spaces (anonymous API)
category: inference through public Gradio Spaces, anonymous callers

free_tier.stated: ZeroGPU Spaces give an unauthenticated caller 2 minutes of GPU quota a day at low queue priority (5 minutes for a free account); a public Gradio chat Space publishes its API schema with no token
free_tier.notes: each Space defines its own endpoint names, such as /generate on huggingface-projects/llama-2-13b-chat; there is no OpenAI-shaped route and no model id echo

tooling: gradio_client or the Space's /gradio_api/call/<api_name> routes; the schema is at /gradio_api/info on current Gradio and /info on older ones
chaining: pairs with ad hoc scripts; the 2 minutes a day of ZeroGPU quota for an unauthenticated caller is the scarce link

limits.value: 2 minutes of ZeroGPU GPU quota per day for an unauthenticated caller, low queue priority; 5 minutes for a free account; the quota resets exactly 24 hours after the first GPU usage

binding_note: the 2 minutes a day of GPU quota binds; a Space on CPU hardware has no such quota stated in the page read

identity_cost.detail: an unauthenticated caller is a documented quota tier (Unauthenticated, 2 minutes, Low queue priority); no token was needed to read /gradio_api/info

reliability_note: a Space can be paused or in an error state, and an older Gradio Space serves its schema at /info rather than /gradio_api/info
confidence_note: the quota is first-party; the schema was read by a keyless GET. No chat call was made because probe issues GET and HEAD only, so a completed answer is unverified

evidence.proved: an unauthenticated caller has 2 minutes of daily ZeroGPU quota at low priority
a free account has 5 minutes a day at medium priority

evidence.quote: Included daily quota resets exactly 24 hours after your first GPU usage.
evidence.proved: the daily quota resets 24 hours after first use
a keyless GET /gradio_api/info answered 200 with a named /generate endpoint on a public chat Space
